description_en: Submit an offline task to generate a 2D digital human video from a WAV audio file. This operation returns a unique TaskUuid immediately. You can use the TaskUuid to query or cancel the task later
description_zh: 提交根据一段wav音频文件生成2D数字人视频任务，该接口会立即返回一个TaskUuid作为本次提交任务的唯一id，后续可以根据TaskUuid调用查询和取消任务接口
kebab_example: aliyun avatar submit-audio-to-2d-avatar-video-task --tenant-id 20516 --app AppId=3d95xx946a --title '常吃的皮蛋一般是由哪一种蛋加工而成的？' --url '可访问的公网url地址' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitAudioTo2DAvatarVideoTask

parameters.help_en: Tenant ID. Get this value from the digitized virtual human Open Platform
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

fields.help_en: App ID. Get this value from the Developer Center > Instance Management page. For details, see References (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/479093.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f66c95dI2Ee#6a48daa1ee899)
fields.help_zh: App ID。在开发者中心-实例管理页面获取对应的appId，参考文档 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/479093.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f66c95dI2Ee#6a48daa1ee899)
fields.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: App information. Represents a business configuration
parameters.help_zh: App信息，代表一个业务配置
parameters.name: app

parameters.example: 常吃的皮蛋一般是由哪一种蛋加工而成的？
parameters.help_en: Task title for the video synthesis. Maximum length: 32 characters
parameters.help_zh: 提交的视频合成的任务标题，最长不超过32个字符
parameters.name: title

fields.help_en:
Alpha channel format. Default: 1.

1: webm

2: mov

3: mp4

<notice>Ignore this field when IsAlpha is false. MOV files with alpha channels are very large. We recommend using webm or mp4 instead.></notice>
<notice>Some 2D digitized virtual humans do not support alpha-channel video. Official Alibaba Cloud digital humans support alpha-channel output. For custom digital humans, alpha-channel support depends on your selection during customization.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
透明通道格式 ，默认值1

1：webm
2：mov
3：mp4

<notice>当isAlpha为false时，该字段忽略。mov格式的透明视频文件大小会非常大，不推荐使用，建议使用webm或者mp4。></notice>
<notice>2D真人数字人部分人物不支持透明格式视频，目前平台官方数字人支持输出透明格式，定制形象需以定制时选择是否透明为准。></notice>
fields.name: alpha_format

fields.help_en: URL of a publicly accessible background image. The image resolution must match the output video resolution. Supported formats: jpg, jpeg, png
fields.help_zh:
有效可访问的url背景图片地址；
背景图片的分辨率必须要与生成的视频分辨率保持一致；
目前支持jpg，jpeg，png的图片格式
fields.name: background_image_url

fields.help_en:
Enable the alpha channel. Default: false.

true: Enable the alpha channel. Set the video format using AlphaFormat. Supported formats: webm, mov, mp4.

false: Disable the alpha channel. The video format is mp4
fields.help_zh:
是否需要透明通道， 默认false

true： 开启透明通道，视频格式可通过AlphaFormat指定，支持webm、mov、mp4
false：不开启透明通道，视频格式为mp4
fields.name: is_alpha

fields.help_en:
Output video resolution. Supported resolutions vary by digital human:

3: 1080 × 1920 (portrait)

4: 1920 × 1080 (landscape)
fields.help_zh:
生成的视频分辨率，不同人物支持不同分辨率：
3：1080 * 1920（竖屏）
4：1920 * 1080（横屏）
fields.name: resolution

fields.help_en: Digital human code. Get this value from the digitized virtual human Open Platform > 2D Assets page. If omitted, the default digital human from the app configuration is used
fields.help_zh: 数字人形象code，从虚拟数字人开放平台-2D资产页面获取，不传则使用应用配置的默认形象
fields.name: code

fields.example:
数字人底板视频为横屏：1080
数字人底板视频为竖屏：1920
fields.help_en: Height of the digital human layer
fields.name: height

fields.example:
数字人底板视频为横屏：1920
数字人底板视频为竖屏：1080
fields.help_en: Width of the digital human layer
fields.name: width

fields.help_en: Horizontal pixel offset of the digital human layer from the top-left corner of the frame. Default: 0
fields.help_zh: 数字人图层相对于画面左上角横轴像素偏移量，原始状态默认为0
fields.name: x

fields.help_en: Vertical pixel offset of the digital human layer from the top-left corner of the frame. Default: 0
fields.help_zh: 数字人图层相对于画面左上角纵轴像素偏移量，原始状态默认为0
fields.name: y

fields.help_en: Output audio sampling rate in Hz
fields.help_zh: 输出音频采样率（单位: Hz）
fields.name: sample_rate

parameters.help_en: URL of the audio file. The audio must be less than 30 minutes long. It must have a 16 kHz sampling rate, one channel, and 16-bit sample depth
parameters.help_zh: 音频的地址url，要求音频时长小于30分钟，采样率16K，单声道，单采样点位深16bit
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Enable event callbacks for this video synthesis task. Default: false. Alibaba Cloud supports callbacks at task start and task completion. For details, see Digital Human Callback Events (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f5876hRJTVU)
parameters.help_zh: 本次视频合成任务是否需要事件回调，默认false不回调。平台支持在任务开始和任务结束时进行事件回调，具体可参考文档：数字人回调事件通知 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f5876hRJTVU)
parameters.name: callback

parameters.help_en: Parameters to pass through with the callback. Must be a JSON string. Ignored when Callback is false
parameters.help_zh: 回调时需要透传的一些参数，json格式字符串，callback=false时不生效
parameters.name: callback_params

TaskUuid.description_en: Unique task ID. Save this value to query task details later
TaskUuid.description_zh: 任务唯一uuid，后续用来查询任务详细请，请务必保存好
